name: How do you choose between garage conversion and new backyard guest house?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to convert a garage instead of building a new detached guest house in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: When is it better to convert a garage instead of building a new detached guest house in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision usually comes down to the condition of the garage, the desired level of quality, and how the homeowner wants the property to function. A conversion can be the most efficient way to gain living space if the structure is usable and the layout works. A detached build is better when the homeowner wants a separate architectural statement, more privacy, or a layout that is not constrained by the old garage shell. In Los Angeles, many owners start by asking which option gives the best overall value, not just the lowest initial cost. The right answer depends on whether the priority is speed, flexibility, or a fully custom result that complements a luxury home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion is usually better when the existing structure is sound, the goal is lower cost, and the owner wants a faster path to a finished unit. A new detached guest house makes more sense when privacy, size, architectural quality, or a custom layout matter more than speed and budget.
